context_requirements: Bacterial 50S ribosomal subunit; human cytosolic and mitochondrial ribosomes are not the intended target.
No known human ortholog of the bacterial 50S subunit that is inhibited by this class.
Any observed transcriptional response would likely reflect off-target or nonspecific effects rather than the intended antibacterial mechanism.
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines.
A shared transcriptional signature across the nine lines that is distinct from generic stress or cytotoxicity signatures.
Evidence that the compounds directly bind and inhibit human mitochondrial or cytosolic ribosomes at 10 micromolar.
